statements: STEP 26 Phase B is a descriptive decomposition; no statistical significance, causal, universal or operational superiority claim is made.
Comparison 2 isolates spatial representation within one product (GLORYS, same cadence, same 15.810070 m depth).
Comparison 4 differs by ocean product, cadence and native depth (15.000 m vs 15.810070 m, difference 0.810070 m); the depth confound is disclosed, not attributed.
Comparisons 1 and 3 remain BLOCKED (HYCOM_DAILY not constructible from existing frames); no re-acquisition was attempted.
The HYCOM reference is the immutable STEP 20 record; STEP 25C is unchanged; alpha = 0.002 is unchanged.
No forcing is selected; no TEST-06 and no STEP 27 follows from this result.
